# stalwart_account_settings (Resource)

Configures default account settings for locale and encryption. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the account
- `encryption_at_rest` (Attributes) Encryption-at-rest settings for the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_at_rest))
- `locale` (String) Preferred locale for the account
- `time_zone` (String) Preferred time zone for the account

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--encryption_at_rest"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_at_rest`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `allow_spam_training` (Boolean) Whether to allow training the spam classifier with plaintext emails before encryption
- `encrypt_on_append` (Boolean) Whether to encrypt emails when they are appended to mailboxes
- `public_key` (String) Public key used for encrypting emails
